info.title: anera markets api
info.description: API for accessing AneraLabs anera.markets data Unauthenticated guests are currently served within the published data windows, but any API key sent must be valid (401 otherwise).

get.description:
Retrieve index families with family metadata, family tickers, and primary index details.

    This endpoint returns:
    - family_name and family_description from MongoDB index_groups
    - family_tickers from visible indices that belong to each family
    - primary_index details from index_groups.primary_index mapped to indices.id
    - primary_index trend (up, down, or neutral) derived from the latest ticker window in ClickHouse

schema.title: Response Get Index Families Api V1 Index Families Get

get.description:
Retrieve all available indices with their complete market data.
    
    This endpoint returns full index information including:
    - All indices with current values and performance metrics (calculated from ClickHouse ticker data)
    - No price history series in list responses (use chart or ticker endpoints for historical prices)
    - Composition history is omitted on list responses; use GET /api/v1/indices/{index_id} for composition history
    - Group/category information (from MongoDB)
    - Featured articles and methodology links (from MongoDB)
    
    **Filtering:**
    - Pass `?featured=true` to return only curated/featured indices (e.g. for homepage carousel)
    - Pass `?featured=false` or omit the parameter to return all visible indices
    - Passing any value other than `true` or `false` returns a `400` error
    
    **Data Sources:**
    - **MongoDB**: Stores index metadata (name, description, group, featured articles, etc.)
    - **ClickHouse**: Stores ticker price data used to calculate performance metrics
    - **Trace Collection**: Stores historical composition data
    
    Use this endpoint when you need complete index data (e.g., for index exploration pages).
    For simplified ticker data (e.g., carousel), use /api/v1/tickers/{symbol} instead.

get.description:
Retrieve summary statistics for indices.

    Returns high-level metrics including total model count and token spend.

Retrieve detailed information about a specific index by its ID.
    
    Returns complete index information including:
    - Current value and all performance metrics (calculated from ClickHouse ticker data)
    - Full composition history from start date (from trace collection)
    - No price history series (use chart or ticker endpoints for historical prices)
    - Group information (from MongoDB)
    - Featured articles and methodology documentation (from MongoDB)
    
    **Data Sources:**
    - **MongoDB**: Stores index metadata (name, description, group, featured articles, etc.)
    - **ClickHouse**: Stores ticker price data used to calculate performance metrics
    - **Trace Collection**: Stores historical composition data
    
    **Example IDs:**
    - `china-model-performance` - China TDI
    - `us-model-performance` - US TDI
    - `europe-model-performance` - Europe TDI
    - `oss-tdi` - OSS index
    - `openai-tdi` - OpenAI TDI
    - `anthropic-tdi` - Anthropic TDI

get.description:
Retrieve the canonical outcome for a prediction market event.

    This endpoint returns the current resolution status of an event:

    - **Unresolved events**: Return `finalised_time = null` and `outcome = null`
    - **Resolved events**: Return non-null `finalised_time` and non-null `outcome`
    - **Unknown events**: Return 404 Not Found

    **Response Fields:**
    - `event_id`: Unique identifier for the event
    - `start_time`: When the event period begins (RFC3339 timestamp)
    - `end_time`: When the event period ends (RFC3339 timestamp)
    - `finalised_time`: When the event was finalised (RFC3339 timestamp or null)
    - `outcome`: Final JSON payload with the result (JSON object or null)

MarketIndex.description:
Complete market index information with performance metrics and history.

Note: Performance metrics (value, change, changeDay, changeWeek, changeMonth, change3Month, etc.) are
calculated dynamically from ticker data stored in ClickHouse, not from the MongoDB index collection.
The MongoDB collection only stores metadata (name, description, group, etc.).
